title: A Repair Before Moving In
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: Two renters coordinate access for a repair before moving day.

transcript.text: The kitchen tap still leaks, and movers arrive Monday. A repair Monday afternoon means working around boxes.
Could they come Saturday? I can meet them, but I do not have the spare key yet. It should be in the lockbox by the door.
I can collect the key Friday. There is a loose shelf too; I will send a photo so they know what to bring.
Great. I will ask if the same person can fix both. If not, the shelf can wait, but the tap needs attention first.
Agreed. I will confirm Saturday and keep the kitchen clear. We should leave cleaning supplies packed until the work is done.

questions.prompt: Why do they want the tap repaired before Monday afternoon?
options: The tap will be removed by the movers.
The repair person is unavailable after lunch.
They are leaving the property on Sunday.
The move is on Monday morning and boxes would make access difficult.
questions.explanation: They say the movers arrive Monday morning and a later repair would take place around boxes and furniture.

questions.prompt: What does Renter B need before meeting the repair person?
options: A copy of the moving schedule
questions.explanation: Renter B says they do not yet have the spare key and expects it in the lockbox.

questions.prompt: Why will Renter A send a photo of the shelf?
options: To prove the shelf is new
To ask the movers to remove it
So the repair person knows what to bring
So Renter B can choose a different room
questions.explanation: They plan to send a photo so the repair person knows which items or tools to bring.

questions.prompt: Which repair do they consider more urgent?
questions.explanation: Renter B says the shelf can wait, but the tap needs attention first.
